title: Check for logical errors for function calls and Objective-C message expressions (e.g., uninitialized arguments, null function pointers).
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-core.CallAndMessage. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check for division by zero.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-core.DivideZero. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check for null pointers passed as arguments to a function whose arguments are references or marked with the 'nonnull' attribute.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-core.NonNullParamChecker. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check for dereferences of null pointers.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-core.NullDereference. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.
